pattern.title: What is a Pattern?
pattern.intro: A pattern is something that repeats or follows a rule.
pattern.example1: Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday... (days repeat every week)

sequence.title: What is a Sequence?
sequence.intro: A sequence is an ordered list of numbers or objects that follow a pattern.
sequence.explanation: Each item in a sequence is called a term. The first term is position 1, the second is position 2, and so on.

numberPatterns.title: 1. Number Patterns
numberPatterns.explanation: Number patterns are sequences where numbers follow a rule. The rule tells us how to get from one number to the next.

shapePatterns.title: 2. Shape Patterns
shapePatterns.explanation: Shape patterns use shapes, colors, or sizes that repeat in a predictable way.

growingPatterns.title: 3. Growing Patterns
growingPatterns.explanation: Growing patterns are patterns that get bigger in a predictable way. Each term adds more elements than the previous term.

patternRules.title: 4. Pattern Rules
patternRules.explanation: A pattern rule describes how the pattern works. It tells you what to do to get from one term to the next, or how to find any term in the sequence.

numberPattern.title: Example: Number Pattern
numberPattern.caption: This pattern shows even numbers. Each number increases by 2.
numberPattern.rule: Rule: Start at 2, add 2 each time

shapePattern.title: Example: Repeating Shape Pattern
shapePattern.caption: The pattern circle-square-triangle repeats over and over.

growingPattern.title: Example: Growing Pattern
growingPattern.caption: Each term adds more blocks following a pattern (adds 2, then 3, then 4...).

shapePatternTypes.title: Types of Shape Patterns:
shapePatternTypes.color: Color patterns - Colors change in a pattern
shapePatternTypes.size: Size patterns - Shapes get bigger or smaller

example1.title: Finding the Next Number
example1.question: What comes next in this pattern? 7, 14, 21, 28, ___
example1.step2: The rule is: add 7 each time

example2.title: Describing a Pattern Rule
example2.question: What is the rule for this pattern? 4, 8, 12, 16, 20
example2.step2: The pattern increases by 4 each time
example2.step3: This is also the pattern of counting by 4s, or multiples of 4
example2.answer: The rule is: start at 4, add 4 each time (or multiply position by 4).

example3.title: Finding a Specific Term
example3.question: In the pattern 5, 10, 15, 20..., what is the 10th term?
example3.step1: Identify the rule: counting by 5s (or 5 times the position)
example3.step2: For the 10th term, use the position number: 10

exercise1.question: What is the next number in this pattern? 3, 6, 9, 12, ___
exercise1.explanation: The pattern increases by 3 each time (counting by 3s), so 12 + 3 = 15.

exercise2.question: What is the 5th term in this pattern? 5, 10, 15, 20, ___
exercise2.hint: This pattern is counting by 5s. What comes after 20?
exercise2.explanation: The pattern increases by 5 each time: 20 + 5 = 25.

exercise3.question: Which pattern rule describes: 2, 4, 6, 8, 10?
exercise3.explanation: Looking at the differences (4-2=2, 6-4=2, etc.), the rule is add 2 each time.

exercise4.question: In the pattern 2, 4, 8, 16, 32, what is the next number?
exercise4.hint: Look at how each number relates to the previous one. Is it doubling?
exercise4.explanation: Each number is double the previous: 32 × 2 = 64.

exercise5.question: What is the 6th term if the rule is 'multiply position by 4'?

notes.title: Tips & Tricks
notes.tip1: 🔍 To find a pattern rule, look at the differences between consecutive terms.
notes.tip2: 📊 Check if the pattern is adding, subtracting, multiplying, or dividing.
notes.trick1: 💡 To find any term quickly, try to write the rule as a formula using the position number.
notes.warning1: ⚠️ Not all patterns are simple! Some patterns might combine different rules or change partway through.

conclusion.title: Excellent Work! 🎉
conclusion.summary: You've learned about patterns and sequences! Understanding patterns helps you predict what comes next, find missing values, and see mathematical relationships. Patterns are everywhere in mathematics and in the world around us!
conclusion.takeaway1: Patterns follow rules that help us predict what comes next
conclusion.takeaway2: Number patterns can increase by adding, multiplying, or other operations
conclusion.takeaway3: Shape patterns repeat in predictable ways using shapes, colors, or sizes
conclusion.takeaway4: Pattern rules can be described in words or as mathematical formulas
